current_p1_findings.summary: Change classifier can false-negative material runtime changes for rename/type-change combinations.
current_p1_findings.target: Use status-aware NUL-delimited Git diff semantics, preserve rename source and destination, detect type/mode/symlink transitions, fail closed on unknown status, and cover with real-Git regression fixtures.

current_p1_findings.summary: Required platform-gate does not provide complete exact-candidate fan-in for all impact-relevant qualification profiles.
current_p1_findings.target: One impact-class to profile manifest, equivalent PR and merge_group classification, stable terminal fan-in that blocks failure/cancelled/missing/unjustified-skipped required profiles.

current_p1_findings.summary: Identity email-change security notifications are persisted and delivered without a durable transactionally coordinated per-message delivery model.
current_p1_findings.target: Transactional outbox or equivalent with idempotency, delivery state, bounded retry, terminal state and restart/expiry/revocation tests.
